## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes, and a behaviour change comes with a test that fails without it.

      single atomic change.
- [ ] The README is updated, if what the tool does from the outside changed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `Unreleased`, if a user would notice this.
